text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=embeddings-eu SEV=2 — high 5xx rate and queue growth (PD#78421). Logs: `error_rate > 0.15`

pagerbot: page acknowledged by alice (on-call) :white_check_mark:

alice: grabbing it, checking dashboards and K/V cache size. tagging @ben for infra assistance.

ben: @alice saw a spike in Redis CPU and small eviction bursts. pulling redis top and recent slowlog. give me 2m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alice: thanks. initial customer impact: some embedding requests delayed ~5-12s, errors for a subset. Not seeing total outage.

carmen: looping in support: triage note -> "embeddings may return 5xx or timeout; retry recommended". I can prepare a status blurb if we want to notify affected customers.

ben: redis slowlog excerpt:
```
1523 0.000542 1 "GET" "emb_cache:xyz"
1524 0.003100 1 "SET" "emb_cache:abc"
1525 0.120345 3 "EVALSHA" "..."
```
looks like a few heavy EVALSHA calls. suspect K/V contention in shard-eu-2.

alice: okay, plan: 1) short-term - scale embeddings worker pool down to avoid queue pile-up and enable fallback model-route; 2) infra - investigate redis shard and apply read-only replica routing for heavy reads; 3) customer comms - carmen to prep. Executing step 1 now.

dave: tagging runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/embeddings-hot-queue — see section "redis-evalstorm". recommend `redis-cli SCRIPT FLUSH` only if we confirm scripted flood.

alice: ran controlled rollback on recent canary (config: batching=auto, kv_prefetch=true -> rollback). queue drain starting.

pagerbot: note: fallback route applied for customers on hosted tier -> using model=embed-v1-small for new requests (no config change required).

ben: seeing reduced slow EVAL traces, queue length dropping from 480 -> 90 in last 2m. Redis CPU down from 95% -> 55%.

alice: customer impact update: errors falling, latency back to ~200ms for most requests. continuing to monitor for 15 more minutes. If stable, will close PD.

carmen: drafting status: "We observed transient errors for embeddings in EU for ~15 minutes; mitigation applied and service recovering. No data loss. We're continuing monitoring and will follow up with post-incident notes."

alice: nice. I'll hold ownership for cleanup and postmortem. If anyone needs to take over, ping me. Otherwise will archive in 30m.

incident-bot: PD#78421 acknowledged by alice at 2025-11-02T14:12:25Z.

ben: :thumbsup: glad that fallback worked.

alice: closing note before handoff: open actions -> (1) analyze evalsha callers, (2) add circuit-breaker for EVAL-like ops, (3) add dashboard alert for redis-eval-latency. tagging @dave for (1) and (2).

dave: on it, will create GH issues and assign.

alice: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
